HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOTTLE.description: At the start of each combat, collect 3 of each basic Color.
HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOTTLE.flavor: Sold in the market as an ornament. It doesn't matter even if you don't know how to paint...
HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOTTLE.title: Palette Bottle
HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOX.description: At the start of each combat, collect 2 of each Color, and an additional 2 of each basic Color.
HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOX.flavor: Filled with Color Bottles of all shapes and sizes.
HATMAGICIAN2-PALETTE_BOX.title: Palette Box
HATMAGICIAN2-BLUE_PAINTING.description: Frost Brand effects are increased by [blue]1[/blue]. The Blend effects of Violet and Radiant Brands are increased by [blue]1[/blue].
HATMAGICIAN2-BLUE_PAINTING.flavor: A painting from an unknown origin, radiating a freezing magic.
HATMAGICIAN2-BLUE_PAINTING.title: Blue Painting
HATMAGICIAN2-YELLOW_PAINTING.description: At the start of each combat, enchant [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards that target enemies with [gold]Lightning[/gold] for the rest of combat.
HATMAGICIAN2-YELLOW_PAINTING.flavor: A cursed pen whose strokes crackle with lightning magic.
HATMAGICIAN2-YELLOW_PAINTING.title: Charged Pen
HATMAGICIAN2-RED_PAINTING.description: At the start of each combat, apply a [red]Fire[/red] Brand to a random enemy.
HATMAGICIAN2-RED_PAINTING.flavor: An ink bottle inhabited by fire spirits; even a single drop will burn for an entire day.
HATMAGICIAN2-RED_PAINTING.title: Burning Inkwell
HATMAGICIAN2-PURPLE_PAINTING.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{Hat2Var}[/blue] [gold]Gloom[/gold] to all enemies.
HATMAGICIAN2-PURPLE_PAINTING.flavor: A flower born in another world that feeds on the spiritual energy of living creatures.
HATMAGICIAN2-PURPLE_PAINTING.title: Purple Flower
HATMAGICIAN2-ORANGE_PAINTING.description: At the end of your turn, deal [blue]{Hat2Var}[/blue] [gold]Chain[/gold] damage. Chain damage is increased by [blue]1[/blue].
HATMAGICIAN2-ORANGE_PAINTING.flavor: A photograph of scenery near nightfall. Time is fleeting.
HATMAGICIAN2-ORANGE_PAINTING.title: Dusk Photograph
HATMAGICIAN2-WHITE_PAINTING.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Doze+[/gold] to your [gold]draw pile[/gold].
HATMAGICIAN2-WHITE_PAINTING.flavor: Its scales absorb light, allowing it to glow and flutter through the night.
HATMAGICIAN2-WHITE_PAINTING.title: Luminous Butterfly
HATMAGICIAN2-RAINBOW_PAINTING.descriptio: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Brand cards, collect {Energy} of all Colors.
HATMAGICIAN2-RAINBOW_PAINTING.flavor: A palette used for mixing magical pigments; instead of turning dark, the colors become brighter when blended.
HATMAGICIAN2-RAINBOW_PAINTING.title: Prismatic Palette
